What We Do

Our Electrical Services

Professional, reliable electrical work for homes, landlords and businesses — all certified under NAPIT Part P registration.

Electrical Installation

Full and partial rewires, new circuits, first and second fix installation for homes and businesses — certified to BS7671.

Consumer Unit Upgrades

Replace an outdated fuse board with a modern consumer unit — safer, compliant and built to current regulations. EIC issued on completion.

EICR Testing

Electrical Installation Condition Reports for landlords, homeowners and commercial properties. Fast turnaround, clear reports across Cheshire East.

EV Charger Installation

Home and workplace EV charger installation across Cheshire East. Load checks, smart charger setup and full certification on completion.

Landlord Services

EICR certificates, remedial works and electrical safety checks for rental properties and letting agents. Compliant, reliable, fully documented.

Fault Finding & Repairs

Tripping circuits, power loss, faulty sockets — fast, efficient fault diagnosis and electrical repair across Congleton and surrounding area.

About Us

Over a Decade of Electrical Experience

Congleton Electrical is run by Tyrone Halligan — a NAPIT-registered electrician with over 10 years of hands-on experience across domestic, commercial and industrial environments, including large-scale commercial and industrial projects across the UK.
